title: Veterans Pension Rate Redetermination — Monthly Care Figure
content:
## Monthly care figure — redetermined annual Veterans Pension

The monthly care figure in a redetermination of the annual Veterans Pension follows the care months reported, that is, the medical expense reports received on the award in the 3 whole months before the redetermination:

| Care months reported | Most recent month (latest expense period start) compared with their average | Monthly care figure |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | above the average | the most recent month |
| 3 or more | at or below the average | the average, rounded to the cent |
| fewer than 3 | — | the total reported |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Care months of 3000.00, 3000.00 and 3300.00, most recent 3300.00: the average is 3100.00 and the most recent is above it, so 3300.00. Care months of 3300.00, 3000.00 and 3000.00, most recent 3000.00: at or below 3100.00, so 3100.00. Two care months of 3000.00: the total 6000.00 stands in place of a monthly figure.
